'''Smart missiles''' were a classification of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. Fitted with a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]], smart [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] could track targets. They cost one thousand five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per missile, and could be used with the [[Morne-3 Concussion Missile Launcher]].<ref name="PP" />
